candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout from inventory to order to gateway. Redis dependency latency/unavailability is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs admitted; whether timeout is redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) causing inventory ReadTimeout, cascading to order and gateway 502s; metrics show /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics to confirm redis saturation vs network timeout
